svg.title: Score terms of two runs
svg.desc: A horizontal bar chart of the ARIAC 2025 score terms for two runs on the same trial, Run 1 in blue and Run 2 in orange. The x axis is points, with grid lines every 1000 from 0 to 7000; the y axis lists the score terms. Base score: Run 1 5000.0, Run 2 3333.3; Bonus: trial time: Run 1 300.0, Run 2 0.0; Bonus: inspection speed: Run 1 125.0, Run 2 0.0; Bonus: high-priority speed: Run 1 120.0, Run 2 0.0; Bonus: sensor cost: Run 1 614.6, Run 2 0.0; Bonus: classification: Run 1 375.0, Run 2 0.0; Penalties: Run 1 -150.0, Run 2 -150.0; Run score: Run 1 6384.6, Run 2 3183.3. Every Run 2 bonus is zero because Run 2 missed one kit.
